serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I’m still thinking about the last post from the blog.
Was the admin really telling the truth? That the only survivor of Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism is a part of his organization? Because if that’s true…{{wi}} what about Big Daddy?
He told me he was in the Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism. Is he part of Admin’s organization?
No way… He wanted me to investigate it so it wouldn’t make sense…
Maybe he’s another survivor?
Or maybe he’s lying…
T-that’s not possible, right? Big Daddy helped me a lot and that Admin guy is just some crazy fanatic.
I was supposed to infiltrate these guys and report to Big Daddy, I can’t have myself getting manipulated and used by some terrorists…
Just thinking about it is stupid, but I can’t stop for some reason… 
Maybe an honest talk with Big Daddy would help clear my doubts…
…but if Admin is telling the truth… {{wi}}it could be the end of me…
I don’t know who to trust…
How about I ask Little Richard about it?
He seems to be willing to answer questions, so it might be a good idea. It shouldn’t hurt. My interest in this matter could show him that I’m dedicated to the cause.
AbusedTenant: Hi, sorry to bother, but I would like to ask about Admin’s recent blog post.
Little_Richard: Geez, why are you being so formal lol
AbusedTenant: Sorry about that…
Little_Richard: What do you want to know?
AbusedTenant: Admin wrote about that other organization called Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism and I found it really interesting that someone tried to create an AI similar to Admin’s before. Do you know more about them?
Little_Richard: I know a thing or two.
Little_Richard: Look, there's a lot of stuff on the internet about them. I can send you some articles.
He seems a little dismissive…
AbusedTenant: I already read a few, but I wanted to hear from someone who witnessed things firsthand.
Little_Richard: Haha! It will be hard for you to find someone like that, there was only one survivor after all, just as Admin wrote.
Little_Richard: If you have some concrete questions about Bot Utopia and Technological Transhumanism I could try answering to the best of my abilities. After all, being a long time member of Admin’s organization I heard a few stories.
Damn.
I didn’t learn who the alleged survivor was.
Prying further could be seen as suspicious, but at least Richard is willing to answer my questions.
AbusedTenant: Thanks! It would be great If you could answer my questions.
AbusedTenant: Do you know how Bot Utopia was created?
Little_Richard: Hmmm…
Little_Richard: It was a long time ago so I don’t remember the details, but basically a bunch of scientists banded together after Derry Tavis’s findings hit the news. They thought that “if one person could make such a huge progress in the AI field, some of the smartest people on Earth, banded together, could achieve a hundredfold.”
AbusedTenant: Did they succeed in surpassing Derry Tavis? 
Little_Richard: Not at first. They were treating the whole thing as more of a hobby and when things started to get political, they decided to use their platform to advocate against AI bans that other scientists were in favor of. 
Little_Richard: Things accelerated when rumors of John Paul 202’s achievements became a thing. Sudden appearance of a genius even greater than Derry Tavis shook the world and the pope's mysterious death accelerated things even further.
Little_Richard: Somehow fragments of the code created by the pope got into hands of Connoisseurs and as their struggle in social debate seemed futile they decided to go full time and create the most powerful AI before the ban was put into place.
Little_Richard: They were really close, but in the end they didn’t succeed. Their organization was infiltrated and they were betrayed. 
Little_Richard: I think they got the closest of anyone trying to achieve a truly thinking AI. Even Derry Tavis couldn’t match their creation, although he disappeared soon after he left the Vatican so who knows what he was up to.
AbusedTenant: I heard that Connoisseurs wanted to create a Proto-God or something like that, how does that play into the story?
Little_Richard: That’s a very obscure piece of knowledge, you know? 
Little_Richard: You are right, some part of Bot Utopia’s members had such an ambition, that’s what inspired the Admin
Little_Richard: By the time AI development was banned, most of the Connoisseurs became disgruntled with the society and they did try to achieve something like a nation of scientists that would be protected by said Proto-God, but that only accelerated their impending doom.
Little_Richard: In hindsight, I think it was the infiltrators that proposed that idea. It gave governments a sort of casus belli to raid all of Connoisseurs’ labs.
Wow…
I didn’t suspect Little Richard’s knowledge to be so vast, it might even rival Big Daddy’s…
Little_Richard: I hope that you have enough answers for today, my eyes are getting watery from looking at the screen so much
AbusedTenant: Yeah, thank you for your time. I learned a lot.
Little_Richard: No problem!
Little_Richard: See ya around!
I was kinda hoping that I could catch him in a lie, but his story matches Big Daddy’s perfectly.
Either way, I’m a few steps closer to learning the whole truth…
